svg.title: Public contribution activity across two GitHub accounts, 2025-11-11 to 2026-11-11
svg.desc: Calendar of daily public contribution counts. Each square combines the personal account @Andrei-Moisa (259 contributions) and the work account @Andrei-Moisa-999 (1,260 contributions) for one day. Combined: 1,519 contributions on 256 of 366 days. Counts are contribution events as each account reports them (commits, pull requests, issues, reviews; private work anonymized), summed by date. Not unique commits. Snapshot fetched 2026-11-11.
